mapper.update: UPDATE business_calendar SET name=#{name},zone_id=#{zoneId},revision=#{revision},updated_by=#{updatedBy},updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND revision=#{expectedRevision}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM business_calendar_version WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND calendar_id=#{id} AND revision=#{revision}
SELECT id,calendar_key,name,zone_id,revision,updated_by,updated_at FROM business_calendar WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND calendar_key>#{calendarKey} ORDER BY calendar_key LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT calendar_id AS id,calendar_key,name,zone_id,revision,updated_by,updated_at FROM business_calendar_version WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND calendar_id=#{id} AND revision<#{revision} ORDER BY revision DESC LIMIT #{limit}
